clauses.english: Because the whole block party got moved up by a full day without much warning, the kitchen crew ended up prepping food for the entire event less than twenty-four hours before it started,

clauses.english: Labels marked which trays needed reheating.

clauses.english: Volunteers arrived an hour before serving started.

script.text: Since the exchange program had postponed the lantern release twice already earlier that month because of rain, the whole group finally gathered together by the lake to hold it properly this time,‖
Someone had written 平安 on their lantern.
and mine drifted sideways into a tree branch almost immediately.‖
A friend climbed halfway up to rescue it.‖
By nine, the lake reflected dozens of lights.‖
A few lanterns drifted all the way to the far shore.‖
Someone started counting how many were still visible.‖
The count reached almost forty before people lost interest.‖
Nobody kept track of the time after that.‖

clauses.english: Since the exchange program had postponed the lantern release twice already earlier that month because of rain, the whole group finally gathered together by the lake to hold it properly this time,
clauses.reference: 由于交换项目那个月因为下雨已经推迟了两次孔明灯活动，大家这次终于聚在湖边把它好好办了起来，

clauses.english: and mine drifted sideways into a tree branch almost immediately.
clauses.reference: 我的那盏几乎立刻就歪着飘进了树枝里。

clauses.english: A friend climbed halfway up to rescue it.
clauses.reference: 一个朋友爬了一半的树去把它救了下来。

clauses.english: By nine, the lake reflected dozens of lights.
clauses.reference: 到九点，湖面上映出了几十盏灯的光。

clauses.english: A few lanterns drifted all the way to the far shore.
clauses.reference: 有几盏灯笼一直飘到了对岸。

clauses.english: Someone started counting how many were still visible.
clauses.reference: 有人开始数还能看见多少盏。

clauses.english: The count reached almost forty before people lost interest.
clauses.reference: 数到快四十盏时大家就没再数了。

clauses.english: Nobody kept track of the time after that.
clauses.reference: 那之后谁都没再看时间。

clauses.english: The catering order called for two hundred small tarts,
clauses.reference: 这份餐饮订单要求做两百个小挞。

clauses.english: so we split the fillings between three people.
clauses.reference: 所以我们把馅料分给了三个人来做。

clauses.english: Lemon curd took the longest to set properly.
clauses.reference: 柠檬奶油花了最长的时间才凝固好。

clauses.english: Each tart shell got blind-baked the night before.
clauses.reference: 每个挞皮前一晚都先空烤过了。

clauses.english: Someone burned the first batch of shells slightly.
clauses.reference: 有人把第一批挞皮烤得稍微有点焦。

clauses.english: We tossed those and started a second batch.
clauses.reference: 我们把那批扔了，重新烤了一批。

clauses.english: Exactly on schedule, the final tray went out.
clauses.reference: 最后一盘正好按时送了出去。
